_note: A `let:` on a plain element or `<svelte:fragment>` that is a child of a component and has no `slot=` fills that component's default slot, so svelte2tsx destructures the name from the parent's `$$slot_def.default`: an unknown name is TS2339 and a known one is typed. Before, such names were declared `any`, so misspelled slot props and misuse of their values passed silently.
